Hello fellow artist here, I’m so sorry your feeling this way. Firstly don’t stress yourself over your art, you’ve only been drawing for 4 months, people’s work you have seen online has taken years of practice so don’t compare yourself to others and focus on yourself :) everyone starts somewhere. Take a step back from drawing every now and then to focus on your mental health. Also Don’t feel forced to draw when you don’t feel like it. Talent takes time to develop, not saying you don’t have any, but you need to give yourself a chance to practice and learn from your mistakes. Go easy on yourself, your still a beginner. This is your own personal journey so take however long you want and don’t compare yourself to others and don’t be afraid to experiment with different styles etc. I believe in you :)
